'''Ogo''' {{Lang|zh=奥戈}} is a quest-exclusive [[NPC]] and a member of the [[Fractsidus]] who appears in the side quest [[Lores Beyond the Ranges]].

His frequencies were combined with (and subsequently devoured by) a [[Lightcrusher]] in a failed experiment.
